searchText: Yeah this is interesting problem. I'm pretty sure it's the runners. I just re-tested this using vmcli on my M1 macbook. It's just a little slower on Linux but that's somewhat expected. The benchmarks: https://gist.github.com/jtraglia/b04d734a35ad1e062fbcec7d7a361ae2 https://github.com/gyf304/vmcli still important to do a real test imo. vm might be good at translation to something we know is already good at kzg (m1) Yeah that's fair. I've also tested on a Rock5 model B. I'm not at home right now and can't re-run benchmarks, but here's some benchmarks for the new DAS functions. Should give an idea of how much slower it is. It's ~6x slower than my macbook. But this is also expected as it's a pretty weak CPU. https://notes.ethereum.org/@dankrad/SyvaiqUC2 It's about 3x less powerful on geekbench & it doesn't support ARM64_CRYPTO instructions. https://browser.geekbench.com/v6/cpu/compare/4973629?baseline=2818821 Err I mean `__ARM_FEATURE_CRYPTO` Do we know which CPU the github runners use? hmmm, not sure, possible the runners are both weak and don't support the right instructions, trying to find more info online https://browser.geekbench.com/v5/cpu/compare/22236423?baseline=21070727 github mentions they use some ampere altra family chip https://github.blog/changelog/2023-10-30-accelerate-your-ci-cd-with-arm-based-hosted-runners-in-github-actions/ so the M1 is probably just way better So I hadn't actually looked at the benchmarks in that PR (https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/actions/runs/7769552403/job/21191010428 then click benchmark) until just now. Wow it's extremely slow. It takes 76ms to verify a kzg proof. This takes about 1ms on other arm64/x86 CPUs. It's hard to believe the Altra core is that slow here. The geekbench link you shared claims that single core performance is 2x worse than the M1, which doesn't really track what we see. We have a rocks5b that we could use for testing and otherwise I think the hetzner cloud arm machines are not a bad benchmark target. do any propsers store blobs on goerli or holesky yet on the beacon chain?
